title: hieracium schultesii subsp. soleirolianum
intro: Hieracium schultesii subsp. soleirolianum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and potentially treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. Bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
